channel.title: The ToolBox releases
channel.description: What changed in each version of The ToolBox

item.title: The ToolBox 1.6.3
item.description: Fix: the Windows and Linux downloads on GitHub build again.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.6.2
item.description: Fixes: Daily mix finds its games again, and music now starts on your first tap even in a page that opened in the background.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.6.1
item.description: Games and the Arcade are now one section, Games & Arcade, with all 84 games in one place.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.6.0
item.description: Music everywhere: soft background music made live on every page, in a style that fits it (chiptune in games, calm pads in tools, dreamy keys in creative apps). Turn it off or change the volume with 🎵 in the corner. It pauses in apps that make their own music.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.5.1
item.description: The AI study buddy, AI app maker and AI dungeon master now work with a key from almost any AI service: Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, xAI, Mistral, DeepSeek, or a model on your own computer (Ollama, LM Studio). The service is recognised from the key, and if a model name is out of date a working one is picked for you.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.5.0
item.description: 30 more Arcade games (70 in all): Who knows who?, charades, hot potato, Would you rather with live votes, Spoons on everyone’s phones, story chain, musical chairs, Playable changelog, Bug pet battles, Git gud dungeon, Pixel wall bounce, Radio rhythm, Codename quiz, Haiku battle, Weather racer, Chore arcade that earns screen time, Reverse snake, Gravity Wordle, Voice runner, Bubble pop cam, Slow riddles, Chess by link, Gamepad party, One-button arcade, AI dungeon master, Daily mix, Mirror world, Wi-Fi arena, Paper level maker and Seasonal fun. Bracket matches can now be played in Pong, Reaction duel, Tic-tac-toe or Connect Four, and Ghost kart has a world ghost to race.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.4.0
item.description: A new Arcade with 40 games: Bug defense, Release rush, Merge conflict, Code golf garden, Commit detective, Escape the CI, chess, checkers, battleship, Connect Four and tic-tac-toe (online too), Snake battle royale, Pixel wall wars, Level jam, Ghost kart, falling blocks, pinball, mini golf with a hole maker, space shooter, Pocket farm, App card battle, rhythm typing, daily sudoku, Bug sweeper, 2048, Whack-a-bug, reaction duel, memory, Simon, hangman, typing racer, Flappy pixel, breakout, Pong, tap tempo, higher or lower, emoji guess, lights out, the 15 puzzle and dice poker.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.3.0
item.description: Two new apps: Bug hunt and the Bug graveyard, a Bug hunter quest, update confetti with a codename and an update streak, “updated” tags on changed apps, changelog search with comic and haiku views, an RSS feed and a vote on what comes next, a live tournament bracket with undo, a second-chance bracket, tap races and app or bug showdowns, pixel wall replay, guide pictures and a snapshot per version, a commit melody and an hourly radio host in Lo-fi, bug reports that include your last steps, a web zip for USB sticks and checksums with every download. Fixes: pixel wall taps near the edge could land on the next pixel.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.2.1
item.description: Tournament bracket: players with the same name are now numbered so the right one moves up.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.2.0
item.description: Snooze and mark-paid buttons on reminders, quiet hours, smart habit reminders, flashcard, water and budget reminders, games pause when you switch windows, a ? sheet on the menu, theme previews, bug reports from Help.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.1.2
item.description: Fixes: paid bills no longer remind you, and games stop moving when you switch windows.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.1.1
item.description: Fixes: Share to The ToolBox opens the right page, and the Arcade tour quest says what counts.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.1.0
item.description: Online multiplayer with room codes (no PC needed), world high scores, Parkour level editor, family settings (profiles, screen time, school and kiosk mode), quests, ToolBox OS, AI app maker, voice commands, party quiz, ToolBox radio, Remix any app, Wrapped, community apps, Spanish/French/Hebrew, reminders, open-with and share-to.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.0.1
item.description: Favorites, Surprise me, daily mix, QR code to the site, installable on Chromebooks, works fully offline, gamepad support, shortcut sheet (press ?), seasonal effects.

item.title: The ToolBox 1.0.0
item.description: A main menu with 6 categories and 43 new apps and games.
